title: GET /config/v2/taxRates answers an array of TaxRate objects; the default PERCENT rate carries its decimal rate

source.note: The operation hands back the restaurant's list of TaxRate objects (at most 300 per page) and requires Toast-Restaurant-External-ID, which names the POS-side restaurant the request is scoped to. TaxRate: guid is the identifier Toast's POS assigns and keeps, entityType names the object's kind, name, isDefault flags whether this is the restaurant's fallback rate, rate holds a percent rate as its decimal fraction -- a 6.25% rate stores as 0.0625, type enum PERCENT|FIXED|TABLE|NONE|EXTERNAL, roundingType meaningful only for PERCENT rates, taxTable and conditionalTaxRates arrays. The seed carries exactly the documented 6.25% example as its one, default rate; the list length is the seed's.
